readings: Linking examinations to patients by `ID` (dropping examinations with no matching patient), how far is patients' `aCL IgM` above or below the overall mean? Within each sex (exact text match, so a blank sex is its own group and a missing sex matches nothing), what is the average of those deviations? Show the top 10 entries whose deviation is above their sex's average deviation, ranked by how far above it they are, largest first (missing last): patient `ID`, `SEX`, `aCL IgM`, its deviation from the overall mean, and how far that deviation exceeds the sex's average deviation. All averages ignore missing values; don't round.
queries:
WITH j AS (
    SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS igm,
           e.`aCL IgM` - AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) OVER () AS dev
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
),
s AS (
    SELECT a.ID, a.SEX, a.igm, a.dev,
           (SELECT AVG(b.dev) FROM j b WHERE b.SEX = a.SEX) AS sex_avg
    FROM j a
)
SELECT ID, SEX, igm AS `aCL IgM`, dev AS deviation, dev - sex_avg AS excess
FROM s
WHERE dev > sex_avg
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
